marta: Quick sync: I prototyped a "micro-core + adapters" approach to unify hosted/dedicated/private. Micro-core = request envelope, observability hooks, and a tiny capability/fallback vocabulary. Adapters implement routing, secrets, and tenancy mapping. Thoughts?
kai: 👍 small core seems right. avoid behavioral defaults in adapters. they must be explicit.
devon: Secrets: core should only carry `secret_ref` strings (no proto for key material). adapters map that -> KMS/HSM. important for audits.
sam: Telemetry: adapters must add tags: `hosting.mode`, `tenant_norm`, `adapter_ver`. normalize tenant id early.
marta: I sketched a minimal manifest: ```{ "core": { "input": "text" }, "ext": { "capabilities": ["stream","kv_cache"], "secret_scheme": "secret://" } }```
kai: Migration: add header `X-Adapter-Compat: legacy|microcore-v1` so control plane can enable shims for old adapters.
devon: Runtime fallback: if app requests `stream=true` but adapter lacks it return structured JSON `{code:412, reason:"capability_missing", hint:"fallback:polling"}`. apps can program against hint.
sam: Also expose `adapter.reported_capabilities` in diagnostics API. dashboards need it.
marta: Ops note: require adapter conformance tests before routing prod traffic. riney-bot: created ticket INF-8050 (adapter conformance harness + mismatch alerts). ETA 3 sprints.
kii: (typo) ignore
kais: next steps: I'll draft adapter shim spec. Devon, you draft secrets mapping + security checklist. Marta will turn this into an RFC. Sam will update tracing/contracts.
marta: Will open RFC tomorrow and tag reviewers. Ping if you want to be on the adapter spec."
